answer_2.quote: We evaluate TAG on DocRED, a widely-adopted DocRE benchmark. Experiments show that: ... (3) Our proposed TAG achieves new state-of-the-art and outperforms prior approaches by a large margin. ... TAG-RoBERTa base attains substantial improvements of 1.07 in COREF F1 and 2.54/2.85 in RE F1/Ign F1 over SOTA on the test set.
